verdict.rationale: Adyen documents risk decisions that block, allow, or review transactions, with review handled through case management. It also offers rules that route payments through 3D Secure step-up, configurable risk profiles and custom rules, plus A/B experiments and backtesting to tune settings to the merchant's appetite. However, no evidence shows ops users mapping explicit risk-score ranges or thresholds to these actions, so the threshold-tuning core of the story is only implied by rule configurability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable score thresholds or score-range-to-action mapping, a link between the ML risk score and 3DS step-up decisions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
